_comment: Explicit host-table policy (ADR 0011). bin/check-host-configs cross-checks auto-mitamae-orchestrator/files/hosts.json (fleet apply targets), lxc-monitoring/files/prometheus.yml node-* scrape jobs, and the host-profile FLEET ip table. Every host that is intentionally in one table and not another MUST be listed here with a reason; anything unlisted that differs FAILS CI. The canonical registry is SSM /host-registry/devices (home-monitor); this file holds only setup-side policy, never host data.

prometheus_only.nrt-router: AWS EC2 subnet router; provisioned by home-monitor scripts, not by auto-mitamae (no /root/setup, no forced-command key)
